Maya K: Heads-up: aiming to publish Adaptive Routing announcement Mar 25 09:15 PT. Need changelog link, staging docs, canary timing, and 2-sentence benchmark for blog. Webinar page + inbound lead routing too. @Jon @Sophie?

Jon P: Docs preview https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/91. Canary: start 08:45 PT at 5% -> 50% by 09:20 -> full by 10:30. Will post deploy note.

Sophie L: Webinar draft https://marketing.redwood.ai/webinars/adaptive-routing-v2  needs CTA. For leads prefer Intercom webhook; need payload fields.

Tom R: Bench blurb idea: "Adaptive Routing cut median token latency ~20% and reduced infra cost ~16% in internal mixed-chat tests." Note KV cache cold-starts in docs. Rollback auto if errors >20% for 3m.

Maya K: Great. Marketing will schedule blog 09:15 PT with short buffer, social 09:35 PT. Sophie please set up Intercom once you have fields.

Sophie L: Will do  need sample payload DM from Jon.

Jon P: I'll DM payload and webhook.
